restrictions: Messages have 36 bytes: independent uniform 256-bit prefix and literal cyclic 32-bit suffix. Seven consecutive records share a suffix; every stratum has m=7*ceil(c*2^128/(7*2^32)) independent prefixes.
Every hash is the exact complete unkeyed two-round BLAKE3-256, length36, root flags11, counter0.

Generation uses an explicit seven-instance packed circuit of 256-bit word primitives with 36-bit lane stride and four guard bits retaining bounded carries. Each operation is charged at 1/430; only terminal verification calls the target-compression primitive, at most twice.
Classical 256-bit word RAM, total work across all processors, explicit full initialization and recovery, no hidden SIMD primitive, advice, heuristic, or claimed full-scale execution.

The packed generation circuit omits fourteen literal-zero additions, folds four initial constant additions, and evaluates only the eight root output words used by the digest; 468 circuit instructions per seven hashes.

Addition reductions are deferred: every a field stays below 15*2^32, every c field below 9*2^32; rotations clean all guard bits and output compaction retains only the low 32 bits per field. This removes 64 AND instructions per seven-hash circuit.

Prefixes are stored into their final records before destructive input packing. Specialized input transpose costs 68 instructions, spacing 96, randomness 7; output wrapper costs 168. Circuit costs 468 after two zero XOR removals; entire seven-sample body costs 884.
